summary: BTC holdings are 9,542.16 coins as of March 31, 2026 (down from 15,000 in prior model); shares outstanding are 276,953,828 as of March 31, 2026, and the company carries $1B face value of 0% convertible senior secured notes due May 2028 at a conversion rate of 28.8 shares per $1.00 of notes (implying ~$0.03472 conversion price per share).

Trump Media issued 2,797,985 new shares of common stock to Foris Holdings US, Inc. and paid $50 million cash in exchange for approximately 684.4 million CRO tokens (valued at ~$105 million); no BTC holdings or debt changes are disclosed in this filing.

TMTG entered into a Business Combination Agreement dated August 25, 2025 with Yorkville Acquisition Corp. (SPAC) and Crypto.com, pursuant to which TMTG will contribute its 'Trump Media Group' brand/IP via a subsidiary to the SPAC in exchange for 10,000,000 SPAC Class A shares, Forced Exercise Warrants for 10,000,000 SPAC Class A shares, and three Earnout Warrants each exercisable for 7% of SPAC outstanding capital stock; this is a pending transaction subject to shareholder and regulatory approval and does not yet change TMTG's BTC holdings, share count, or debt structure.

Owner-approved correction of the 10-Q extraction: (1) conv_price 0.034722 -> 34.722 -- the filing HTML renders the XBRL-scaled denominator as "per $1.0 of Notes" (scale=3, i.e. per $1,000); 28.8 shares per $1,000 = $34.722/share, matching the note"s issue-time premium. The per-$1 reading made the note falsely deep-ITM (+28.8B phantom shares, CEBE 0). (2) debt_face 1000000000 -> 0 -- the same $1.0B note was double-entered as straight debt AND a convert tranche; the 10-K confirms it is the sole debt instrument.
